topic: Ukraine's share of global neon supply (2022)
disagreement: USITC says Ukraine supplied approximately half of the world's neon; TrendForce says nearly 70% of world neon gas capacity.
possible_reasons: Different grades (all neon vs purified semiconductor-grade)
Neither source discloses method or base year
rationale: USITC is a tier-1 government source describing actual supply; TrendForce figure refers to capacity, which can exceed output.
remaining_uncertainty: No primary production statistics for semiconductor-grade neon by country were found; the true share of chip-grade supply may differ from both.

topic: TSMC's share of the foundry market
disagreement: CSET gives TSMC 54% of the logic foundry market (2020); TrendForce gives 72.5% (2Q26).
possible_reasons: Different populations (all logic foundries vs top-10 foundries' combined revenue)
Genuine share gain driven by leading-edge/AI demand
rationale: Not a true conflict; both may be correct for their period and definition. Use the TrendForce figure for current state, noting it excludes foundries outside the top 10.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether 'foundry' includes IDM foundry units (e.g. Samsung Foundry, Intel Foundry) and how intra-company sales are treated.

topic: US share of global semiconductor manufacturing
disagreement: White House (2021) says 12% of global production 'today'; SIA (2026) says 10% of global fabrication capacity by 2022.
rationale: SIA states the metric (fabrication capacity) and year (2022) explicitly; the 2021 figure's basis is unstated.
remaining_uncertainty: Wafer-size normalisation and whether foreign-owned US fabs are included were not checked.

topic: WSTS forecast of the 2026 global semiconductor market
disagreement: WSTS forecast USD 975bn for 2026 in December 2025 and USD 1.51 trillion in Spring 2026.
possible_reasons: Forecast revision between vintages driven by memory price surge (~250% memory growth)
rationale: Same organisation, same definition; the later vintage incorporates more recent data.
remaining_uncertainty: Both are forecasts; actual 2026 outcome unknown. The Spring 2026 release date was not visible on the page.
